title: pouzolzia wightii var. neilgherrensis
intro: Pouzolzia wightii var. neilgherrensis, commonly known as Nilgiri Pouzolzia or Nilgiri country bitters, is a plant species belonging to the family Urticaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine and is valued for its various health benefits, which include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pouzolzia wightii var. neilgherrensis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which have been identified as responsible for its medicinal properties.
